ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 0.05 to 0.10; the surface is characterized by a high density of low-intensity pixels with sparse high-intensity clusters concentrated strictly at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; sparse, non-contiguous light-gray mottling visible on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees; notch depth constitutes approximately 20% of the visible vertical height of the central lobe region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations increases significantly on the distal thirds of both lobes compared to the regions proximal to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, exhibiting a wide-reaching parabolic sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the terminal tips of both lobes, suggesting rugose surface anomalies.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white encrustations at the lateral tips; irregular secondary notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Near-uniform low-intensity (dark) pigmentation across the majority of the visible fluke surface area.
